description: Read and write Bluesky: home, custom, list and author feeds, post threads, search, profiles and follower graphs, notifications and direct messages, and create/delete posts, like, repost, follow, block-list, mute and chat actions on bsky.app in your current tab. Uses your own logged-in Bluesky session.

tools.name: get_timeline
tools.description: Get the authenticated user's home timeline. Returns posts from followed accounts, sorted chronologically. Supports cursor-based pagination.

tools.name: get_feed
tools.description: Get posts from a custom feed generator (e.g., Discover, What's Hot). Requires the feed AT URI.

tools.name: get_author_feed
tools.description: Get posts by a specific user. Filter by post type: posts_with_replies (default), posts_no_replies, posts_with_media, or posts_and_author_threads.

tools.name: get_post_thread
tools.description: Get a post and its reply thread. Returns the root post and nested replies. Use depth to control how many levels of replies to fetch.

tools.name: get_posts
tools.description: Get multiple posts by their AT URIs. Returns up to 25 posts in a single request.

tools.name: get_list_feed
tools.description: Get posts from a user list. Requires the list AT URI.

tools.name: create_post
tools.description: Create a new Bluesky post. Supports plain text. For replies, provide the parent and root post URIs and CIDs.

tools.name: delete_post
tools.description: Delete a post by its AT URI. Only the post author can delete their own posts. The rkey is extracted from the URI.

tools.name: search_posts
tools.description: Search for posts matching a query. Supports filtering by author, mentions, language, URL, domain, and tags. Results can be sorted by latest or top.

tools.name: like_post
tools.description: Like a post. Requires the post's AT URI and CID. Returns the URI of the like record (needed for unliking).

tools.name: unlike_post
tools.description: Remove a like from a post. Requires the AT URI of the like record (returned by like_post).

tools.name: repost
tools.description: Repost a post. Requires the post's AT URI and CID. Returns the URI of the repost record (needed for unreposting).

tools.name: unrepost
tools.description: Remove a repost. Requires the AT URI of the repost record (returned by repost).

tools.name: get_current_user
tools.description: Get the authenticated user's profile including name, handle, bio, follower counts, and avatar.

tools.name: get_user_profile
tools.description: Get a user's profile by their DID or handle. Returns detailed profile information including bio, follower counts, and viewer relationship.

tools.name: get_user_profiles
tools.description: Get multiple user profiles in a single request. Accepts up to 25 DIDs or handles.

tools.name: search_users
tools.description: Search for users by keyword. Returns paginated results matching the query against handles and display names.

tools.name: search_users_typeahead
tools.description: Typeahead search for users. Returns a quick list of matching users for autocomplete. Faster than full search but returns fewer results.

tools.name: get_followers
tools.description: Get a user's followers list. Supports cursor-based pagination.

tools.name: get_follows
tools.description: Get the list of accounts a user follows. Supports cursor-based pagination.

tools.name: follow_user
tools.description: Follow a user. Requires the target user's DID. Returns the follow record URI (needed for unfollowing).

tools.name: unfollow_user
tools.description: Unfollow a user. Requires the AT URI of the follow record (returned by follow_user or found in the viewer relationship).

tools.name: get_blocks
tools.description: Get the list of accounts blocked by the authenticated user. Supports cursor-based pagination.

tools.name: mute_actor
tools.description: Mute a user. Their posts will no longer appear in your feed.

tools.name: unmute_actor
tools.description: Unmute a user.

tools.name: mute_thread
tools.description: Mute a thread. Notifications from this thread will be suppressed.

tools.name: unmute_thread
tools.description: Unmute a thread.

tools.name: list_notifications
tools.description: List the authenticated user's notifications including likes, reposts, follows, mentions, replies, and quotes. Supports cursor-based pagination.

tools.name: get_unread_count
tools.description: Get the count of unread notifications.

tools.name: mark_notifications_seen
tools.description: Mark all notifications as seen up to the current timestamp.

tools.name: list_conversations
tools.description: List the authenticated user's direct message conversations. Returns conversations sorted by most recent activity.

tools.name: get_conversation
tools.description: Get details about a specific conversation by its ID.

tools.name: get_messages
tools.description: Get messages in a conversation. Returns messages sorted by most recent first.

tools.name: send_message
tools.description: Send a direct message in a conversation.

tools.name: delete_message
tools.description: Delete a message for yourself in a conversation.

tools.name: mute_conversation
tools.description: Mute a conversation to stop receiving notifications from it.

tools.name: unmute_conversation
tools.description: Unmute a conversation.

tools.name: mark_conversation_read
tools.description: Mark a conversation as read.
